description: The >>SOURCE [FORMAT] [IS] { FIXED | FREE } compiler directive (ISO §2023:7.3.24) - it switches the reference format of the source or library text that follows. Implemented by ReferenceFormatProcessor, which runs BEFORE the conditional-compilation driver (it must, to normalize the text), so the introduction gate for this ONE directive emits there rather than at the shared directive-recognition point. The §2023:7.3 compiler-directive facility is a COBOL-2002 introduction: COBOL-85 has no compiler directives at all, so a '>>' line cannot occur in a conforming COBOL-85 source. The edition edge below 2023 is DERIVED, not quoted (VCR Table 7's discipline, rows 7.19/7.20 - the repo holds no 2002 or 2014 text, ratified decision #1): the derivation is (a) the M2 post-85 feature catalog in docs/ISO2023_CONFORMANCE_PLAN.md, which places '*>' inline comments, >>SOURCE FORMAT, conditional compilation and 'recognize-and-ignore of the other standard >> directives' in COBOL-2002, (b) the sibling row leap-second-directive-2002, already landed on the same derivation (kb/Work PB65), and (c) Annex E, which itemizes the 2014->2023 delta and does NOT list this directive among the additions, so it predates 2023. Overturnable in one line if the 2002/2014 text is ever acquired.
citation: ISO §2023:7.3.24; the §2023:7.3 compiler-directive facility is a COBOL-2002 introduction (M2 catalog derivation, VCR Table 7 discipline)

directiveOperand.citation: ISO §2023:7.3.24.2 general format (rendered from the printed page, folio 84): SOURCE, FIXED and FREE are underlined required words and FORMAT/IS are not, so per §2023:5.2.3 they are optional words and exactly one of FIXED or FREE shall be written; §2023:7.3.24.3 GR1 has no answer for the following text otherwise.

source:
>>SOURCE FORMAT IS FIXED
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. PB725SF.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           DISPLAY "X".
           STOP RUN.
